meta.description: TaoMenu — store owner and staff PWA

login.title: Store sign-in
login.subtitle: Use Google or email OTP. No password needed.
login.hint: OTP is sent by email (Cloudflare Email). If EMAIL is not configured in dev, check logs for [taomenu-otp]. Google only appears when OAuth is configured.

onboarding.title: Open a store
onboarding.subtitle: Phone only. Finish in a few minutes — menu and QR come next.
onboarding.storeNameHint: You can change this later in settings.
onboarding.modeTableDesc: One QR code per table. Pickup point optional.
onboarding.modeCounterDesc: Small shops with little seating. Use pickup codes and queue numbers.
onboarding.modeHybridDesc: Both table service and takeaway / counter pickup.
onboarding.counterHint: Shops with few or no seats do not need table numbers. Next you only need a pickup code.
